ABOUT NEWLA

Do the work. Keep the proof.

A workspace built around the feeling that finishing something is worth remembering.

Why Newla exists

We make things every day.

A painting. A sketch. A project. A solved problem.

And when we're done, we often take a photo.

Not because we have to.

Because finishing something feels good — and we want to remember that we did it.

Newla brings that idea into everyday work.

Instead of ending with a checkbox, your work can leave a trace.

THE NEWLA LOOP

From intention to evidence.

Task→Work→Proof→Completed

A checkbox says you finished. A proof shows that you did.

BUILT FOR REAL WORK

Keep the work close.

Tasks, focus, ideas, notes, calendar and proof stay in one place, so the work doesn't get scattered across different tools.

MADE TO STAY QUIET

Let the interface get out of the way.

Newla is designed to help you work without becoming another thing demanding your attention.

YOUR WORK STAYS YOURS

Keep your workspace personal.

Your workspace is tied to your account, with private proof storage and user-level access controls.

HOW NEWLA THINKS

01

Plan it.

Decide what matters.

02

Make it.

Do the actual work.

03

Prove it.

Capture what you finished.

04

Keep moving.

Start the next useful thing.

A QUIET IDEA

Sometimes the best part of finishing something isn't seeing a checkbox turn green.

It's looking at what you made and thinking:

I did that.
